messages:
nina: PR #4360 touches structured-output.md and our sample schema. Two tiny problems: 1) the schema file referenced is unversioned (`/docs/schemas/structured-output.json`) and we should point to v3; 2) the example extractor uses `tool_call` as a string literal instead of the constant we document (should be `type: \u201ctool_call\u201d` but ok - actually that's the same i guess). Also see comment: the YAML frontmatter still says `last_updated: 2024-06-03` which is wrong (this was from a fork).

jon: thanks Nina. I'll quick-fix frontmatter date. For the v3 link, do we have redirect in place?

links-bot: quick note: there is an nginx redirect from /docs/schemas/structured-output.json -> /docs/schemas/structured-output-v3.json for incoming traffic, but internal canonical links should use v3.

sylvia: Could we also add a tiny test to the examples CI that loads the schema and validates the sample extractor JSON? We already have ajv in docs tests.

nina: yes please. Add a test that runs ajv validate(sample, schema) and fails if not valid. Keep test minimal.

jon: pushed small fixes: updated frontmatter date, swapped link to v3, and added ajv test. PTAL.

sylvia: lgtm. One nit: test name should be `test: structured-output schema matches example extractor` to be discoverable.

merge-bot: build/docs-tests 1 running...

links-bot: note: external CDN returned 502 earlier in checks but build retry resolved it.

merge-bot: build/docs-tests 1 success.

nina: thanks team! Merging now. We'll follow up with a small note in release notes about tightening schema validation in CI.

sylvia: follow-up idea: add a small section to structured-output.md about "schema-driven example extractors" describing why we keep versioned schemas and how to bump them. Could draft if helpful.

nina: yes please draft, target ~3 short paragraphs. We'll land in a subsequent PR. Closing.
